MY SHAPE STUDIO

Plan My Picture

Imagine what circles, squares, triangles and rectangles could become.

Look, then try.

Use the house, robot and flower as starting ideas, or invent something different. Plan the largest pieces first. Leave room for smaller details and try overlapping two shapes to see what changes.

Start drawing and writing below

Open the worksheet to print or save

Create with a grown-up. An adult helps with cutting. Use child-safe glue, keep small scraps out of mouths and keep devices away from glue.

Use a finger, stylus or mouse in each drawing box. Type below it, or ask a grown-up to write your words. Your work stays in this tab. Save before refreshing or leaving.

Your ideas belong here. There is no score.

What are we learning?

Planning helps us choose and explain an idea while leaving room to change our minds.
